warnings: Grid printed in bubbles on all three structural plans: x = 1-9 (8 bays x 4.50 = 36.00), y = ก ข ค (6.00 + 3.00 = 9.00), origin ก1 top-left. The three plans agree on every main dimension.

Dummy lines from printed chains: 1' / 9' (1.00 floor/roof edge past grids 1 and 9), ก'' / ค' (1.00 floor edge, S-01), ก' / ค'' (1.60 roof eave, S-03), ก''' (3.00 mid-bay B3 line, printed 3.00 | 3.00 on S-02), ข''' (2.40 below ข = 0.60 above ค, corridor-edge beam B1 line, printed on S-01 and S-02).

Stair wells: the enlarged stair plans A-10 (หน้า12) print 1.67 | 2.43 | 0.40 between grids 1 and 2 and a 1.40 flight width from row ข, giving 1'' 1.67, 1''' 4.10 and ข' 7.40. The structural plan S-02 draws the inner stair beam B5 at ~1.75 by scale; the printed 1.67 is taken (printed value wins). The grid 8-9 stair is not dimensioned anywhere, so its inner beam line 8' is placed by symmetry (36.00 - 1.67 = 34.33; S-02 scales ~34.2) with a lowered score.
Before-origin dummies share the first main line's prime sequence (section 4): y ก' -1.60, ก'' -1.00, then ก''' 3.00 in the ก-ข gap.

op04 time-boxed sweep: dimension chains come from the three structural plans (S-01..S-03), the floor plans A-02/A-03 (หน้า04/05) and the cross-sections A-07/A-08 (หน้า09/10). The elevations A-05/A-06 (หน้า07/08) print only the z chain (no horizontal dimension rows) and were swept for it. The roof plan A-04 (หน้า06), the longitudinal section A-09 (หน้า11) and the stair plans A-10 (หน้า12) were swept too. The stair section A-11 (หน้า13) was swept as well. The detail sheets A-12..A-16 (หน้า14-18: bench/eave/lintel, door/window, chalkboard details) print only element-internal dimensions, recorded in unassigned_dimensions[] (main dimension lines; the door/window ones also live on the schedule elements). Not swept: the cover/title pages (หน้า1-2), the index/legend A-01 (หน้า3), which print no dimensions. The electrical plans EE-01/EE-02 (หน้า29-30) were swept: EE-01 adds the 2.25 tick (ข'') that no other sheet prints.

Conflict: both cross-sections A-07 and A-08 print grid bubble ก on the 3.00-wide side (stair/corridor) and ค on the 6.00 side, the reverse of the three structural plans and both floor plans A-02/A-03 (ก-ข 6.00, ข-ค 3.00). Taken: the plans (precedence 1 — structural plans win, and five plan sheets against two sections); the section chains are recorded with the plan-consistent ids and their printed order kept in each chain note.
Footing depths printed on S-06/S-08 (1.00 / 1.20 below ระดับดินเดิม) are member-detail dimensions kept on the footing elements, not z_levels.
